EDSA REHAB BEGINS TOMORROW, DEC. 24 🚧

As one of Metro Manila’s busiest and most traffic-prone roads, EDSA is set to undergo phased rehabilitation in the next eight months aimed at improving road conditions while limiting disruption.

Here’s what motorists and commuters need to know. #INQExplains

data.text: Bengaluru traffic Advisory (Dec 24–25): On Christmas Eve, traffic restrictions will be in place near Phoenix, VR and Nexus Shantiniketan malls (Mahadevapura) from 12pm to 11pm on Dec 24, with parking curbs, cab pick-up points and diversions. Davis Road (Pulakeshinagar) will be closed from 7pm Dec 24 to 12pm Dec 25 due to Holy Ghost Church celebrations.
